_note: Alert levels and the rules that raise them. notify: 'onduty' = all on-duty officers, 'oncall' = all on-call officers, otherwise a contact id from duty.json. A1 only SIMULATES notifications. These are placeholder procedures, not reviewed security advice.

levels.name: Notify duty officer
actions: Duty officer views the camera images
Greeter or officer makes friendly contact and verifies
Officer clears or escalates in the console

levels.name: Call in security
actions: Officer on radio keeps person under observation
Call contract security / on-call officers to the site
Hold inner doors closed until cleared

levels.name: Lockdown / shelter in place
actions: Move people away from doors and windows
Officer keeps camera watch and reports to police

levels.name: Evacuate
actions: Use exits away from the threat (east / rear)

rules.name: Person in a zone they are not allowed in
Object of concern + unrecognized person in zone 1 or 2
